children: Data showing Australian wages growth grew at its fastest quarterly pace in nearly three years in 3Q 2026 will do nothing to assuage the Reserve Bank of Australia's deepening concern that elevated inflationary expectations are becoming embedded. RBA Governor Michele Bullock made reference to rising expectations on Tuesday, adding that inflation risks remain skewed upward. The 1.1% quarterly rise in wages is also consistent with the RBA's view that the job market retains some tightness. The path to a further interest rate rise remains visible.
